entities.summary: The Battle of the Trent was fought at an unspecified site near the River Trent within the Kingdom of Lindsey, in 679. The battle was fought between the Northumbrian army of King Ecgfrith and the Mercian army of King Æthelred. The Northumbrians were victorious, ending Mercian domination of the area. Lindsey remained part of Northumbria until Mercia retook it 701.
